title: As Agents Move Beyond the Chat Box, Authorization and Accountability Must Keep Pace
description: Wider Gemini access, purchasing-intent credentials, an AI companion platform’s bankruptcy, and a regulatory hearing; two conversations and hidden-capability research examine the boundaries of trust.
